image_description: A close-up, slightly angled shot of a physical paper menu. The menu features a beige/cream background with dark text. It includes a stylized logo at the top left, followed by sections for 'Appetizers', 'Entrees', and 'Desserts'. The text appears to be in a serif font, but upon closer inspection, the characters are nonsensical and illegible (gibberish), mimicking the structure of real words without forming actual language. There is a small circular graphic on the right side.

The logo is an abstract mess of lines that doesn't form a coherent symbol or letter, indicating a failure to generate specific branding geometry.
